title: Software is made between commits
summary: Zed introduces DeltaDB, a new database system designed to track and manage software changes between commits, enabling real-time collaboration and change synchronization for developers working on shared codebases.
problem_solved: Provides efficient tracking and synchronization of incremental changes in software development, enabling seamless collaborative editing without conflicts.
why_valuable: Enables developers to capture, sync, and replay changes between commits in real-time, fundamentally improving how software teams collaborate and track project evolution.
